content:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to lift feature flag `routing.v2` to 20% tomorrow 11:00 PDT. Keeping safe defaults on. Who can own the smoke checks and the rollback window?
Tara: I can own smoke between 11:00–11:30. Will run the usual smoke checklist and watch SLOs. @Alex please share rollout playbook + rollback command.
Alex: Thanks @Tara. Playbook snippet below — flip via ops-flag service. Quick commands:
```
# enable 20% rollout
ops-flag set routing.v2 --percent 20 --meta "canary:eng-platform"
# rollback to 0%
ops-flag set routing.v2 --percent 0 --meta "rollback"
```
Sam: FYI the safedefaults setting is `routing.v2.safedefault=true` — we will keep it true for EU tenants. I pushed a config that prevents full lift unless signal_ok tag is present.
Ben: I'll be online at 10:45 and can help with customer-facing checks. I'll validate critical flows for billing and embeddings routes at +5m and +20m after flip.
Tara: Checklist I'll run (short): 1) smoke generate on sample apps, 2) tail infra error rate, 3) verify latency p50/p95, 4) check traces for model fallback. If anything > 2x baseline or errors spike, I'll request immediate rollback.
Alex: Monitoring links — app dashboards, traces, and the rollout page:
- https://console.redwood/rollouts/routing.v2
- https://console.redwood/metrics/app?query=error_rate
Also will trigger deploy-bot for a short status ping at start and +15m.
deploy-bot: scheduled status pings set at 11:00 and 11:15. I'll post a thread update then. :robot_face:
Ben: LGTM. I'll mark the customer-impact channels and notify CS briefly before flip. :thumbsup:
Tara: OK, I'm owner for smoke. If no critical regressions by 11:35, @Alex you can approve bump to 50% in the afternoon. Otherwise we'll hold and triage.
Alex: Perfect. Locking window: tomorrow 11:00 PDT. Ownership: Tara (smoke & rollback), Ben (biz validation), Sam (config guard). Ping in this thread if anything changes. :pray:
